A note journey, read in order

REL-HOST-GUEST-MENTAL-MODEL-001

Conceptual mediated authority path

  1. Learner's noteA note is considered in a conceptual learning scenario; this site does not create or send it.
  2. Untrusted nappletA focused guest asks for a declared capability rather than possessing host authority.
  3. Trusted hostThe host evaluates policy and may mediate the request; no host runs in this static site.
  4. Result boundaryA bounded result returns to the guest model; protocol envelopes and runtime behavior remain unresolved.
